items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And the only reason why Connors beat him in Salt Lake City is because of the difference in age and the power.

ctx.x: trick... And the only reason why Connors beat him in Salt Lake City is because of the difference in age and the power. Because as far as the smarts is concerned, Connors was still getting the smarts. Rosewall already had 'em. But he's too old. No way...

You know, your eyes go. That's one of the most important things in tennis. People don't realize, if your eyes are not absolutely perfect, you're through. Because if you have to get up against a guy who's got a fast serve, you've got to be able to see that ball. Man, you can't just depend on anticipation.
